mapper.sql: left join lateral ( select case when p.system_pipeline_code = 'PROCESS' and s.step_status = 'SUCCESS' then case when s.stage_code = 'COMMIT' then s.output_summary -> 'publishedCount' else s.output_summary -> 'processedCount' end end as value ) process_summary on true left join lateral ( select case when jsonb_typeof(process_summary.value) = 'number' then process_summary.value::text::numeric end as value ) process_count on true

coalesce(pr.processed_count, case when process_count.value between 0 and 9223372036854775807 and trunc(process_count.value) = process_count.value then process_count.value::bigint end) as rows_processed
